dominant_confusion_flows.mechanism: Lexical Overlap Artifact: Common NDA boilerplate words create high cosine similarity with hypothesis n-grams, triggering false Entailment predictions.
Polarity Negation Blindness: Bag-of-words / n-gram TF-IDF fails to capture subtle legal qualifiers, exceptions, and scope negations ('solely', 'except as provided').
Dispersed Evidence: The obligation is stated across non-contiguous clauses, diluting document-level TF-IDF signal.

failure_modes.description: 2,833 classes have 0 training examples and 8,465 have <10 examples in the 10% subset. The model is incapable of generalizing to tail classes under frozen-encoder fine-tuning.
failure_modes.name: Extreme Long-Tail Starvation & Zero-Shot Collapse

failure_modes.description: At tau=0.50, recall is 0.94% (99.06% of true labels missed). Lowering to tau*=0.04 recovers 12.8x recall, but inflates false positives by 134.6x (from 438 to 58,947), capping micro-precision at 17.72%.
failure_modes.name: Precision-Recall Threshold Dilemma

failure_modes.description: Because the 109.5M Legal-BERT encoder parameters are frozen, domain-specific contract risk representations cannot be learned end-to-end; the linear classification head is constrained by general masked-language-model features.
failure_modes.name: Linear Probe Representation Bottleneck

failure_modes.description: TF-IDF baselines on ContractNLI over-predict Entailment (62.5% of all predictions) because legal boilerplate shares vocabulary with hypotheses even when obligations are absent.
failure_modes.name: Lexical Overlap Without Semantic Entailment

failure_modes.description: Gradient-based evidence attribution assigns disproportionate weight to frequent syntax tokens. Explanation sparsity (Gini 0.39-0.56) must not be confused with legal explanatory validity.
failure_modes.name: Gradient Saliency Noise & Stopword Dominance

extreme_tail_rare.explanation: Extremely sparse supervision under binary cross-entropy prevented linear head from learning robust class boundaries.

head_common.explanation: Frequent legal provisions (e.g. governing laws, terminations) driving the vast majority of true positives.

moderate_tail.explanation: Sufficient examples for basic feature association, but constrained by frozen encoder representation.

zero_shot_unlearned.explanation: Zero positive training instances in 10% subset; frozen encoder + random head received zero/negative updates, leading to near-zero test logits.

ledgar_classification_error_analysis.macro_f1_collapse_root_cause: Macro-F1 is an unweighted arithmetic mean across all 12,407 evaluated classes. Because 2,833 classes (22.5%) have zero training examples and 8,465 classes (67.1%) have under 10 examples, over 90% of classes have near-zero recall and F1=0, which drags the macro average down to 0.0045 despite solid head-class performance.

representative_concrete_cases.analysis: The 12,407-label LEDGAR taxonomy contains distinct near-synonym and morphological variants ('governing law' singular vs 'governing laws' plural vs 'applicable laws'). The model correctly detected the governing law concept, but because binary evaluation requires exact string matching, it was simultaneously penalized with a false positive and two false negatives.
representative_concrete_cases.evaluation_outcome: 1 False Positive ('governing laws') + 2 False Negatives ('applicable laws', 'governing law')
representative_concrete_cases.provision_text: This Agreement shall be governed by, and construed in accordance with, the laws of the State of Delaware, without giving effect to any principles of conflicts of law.

representative_concrete_cases.analysis: Because the model classification head was trained over a frozen BERT encoder on a 10% subset, output logits for multi-label provisions are heavily squashed. Even though the clause is an explicit termination provision, its output probability (0.0092) is below tau* = 0.04, causing an outright false negative.
representative_concrete_cases.evaluation_outcome: False Negative (Target omitted from prediction set)
representative_concrete_cases.provision_text: Either party may terminate this Agreement without cause at any time effective upon thirty (30) days prior written notice to the other party.

representative_concrete_cases.analysis: High frequency of words 'confidentiality', 'information', 'party', and 'disclosed' in the NDA text misled the linear SVM into predicting Entailment, despite the contract lacking any explicit public-domain carveout exception.
representative_concrete_cases.document_context: The receiving party agrees to maintain confidentiality of all proprietary information disclosed during business operations...
representative_concrete_cases.hypothesis: Confidential Information shall not include information that is publicly known.

representative_concrete_cases.analysis: GradientXInput attributes high local sensitivity to common function words ('and', 'the') and syntax markers rather than substantive legal terms ('State of New York', 'laws'). While character offsets are 100% mathematically aligned, the highlighted tokens do not constitute an acceptable legal rationale.
representative_concrete_cases.provision_text: This Agreement shall be governed by, and construed in accordance with, the laws of the State of New York.
